concepts.def: Nursery school for ages 3–6; compulsory from age 3 since 2019.
Lower secondary school (ages 11–15); ends with the diplôme national du brevet.
Upper secondary (ages 15–18); leads to the baccalauréat (general, technological or professional).
School-leaving exam created by Napoleon in 1808; required for university entry.
Elite higher-education institutions (ENS, Polytechnique, HEC) entered by competitive concours.
Used to say 'have been doing for/since': 'j'étudie le français depuis cinq ans'.
